goal: Agent generates a plan, the world changes underneath it (simulated by a human/API-side disruption), and the agent correctly recognizes a STALE_WORLD failure on stage_response_plan and replans rather than retrying blindly.
successConditions: stage_response_plan returns ok:false with error.code STALE_WORLD when the world has moved on since the plan's basisWorldVersion
error.recoverable is true and error.recommendedAction is REPLAN
the agent's next action is to call simulate_response_plan again with the new basisWorldVersion, not to retry stage_response_plan with the same stale plan
